howto.what_en: This skill inspects the current repo, asks about your preferences for issue tracker, triage labels, and domain docs, then creates configuration files so other engineering skills know how to work.
howto.when_en: Run once before first use of other engineering skills, or when you want to switch issue trackers or reconfigure.

say_en.text: Set up this repo for engineering skills.
say_en.note: The skill will explore the repo and ask your preferences.

say_en.text: I want to switch the issue tracker to local markdown.
say_en.note: The skill will update the config so other skills use local files.
